normalization_plan.reason: constructor parameter _initialAmount only feeds constructor initialization
constructor parameter _tokenName only sets the name state variable in the constructor
constructor parameter _decimalUnits only sets decimals in the constructor
constructor parameter _tokenSymbol only sets symbol in the constructor
constructor parameter _owner initializes owner and the initial balance
constructor parameter _lockedAddress is only iterated inside the constructor loop
constructor parameter _lockedBalances is only written into lockedBalances in the constructor
constructor parameter _lockedTimes is only written into lockedBalances in the constructor
local loop index i exists solely in the constructor lock-initialization loop
transfer parameter _to is a transient recipient argument of the transfer function
transfer parameter _value flows directly into the unchecked balance arithmetic
burnFrom parameter _who is a transient account argument of burnFrom
burnFrom parameter _value flows directly into the unchecked supply/balance decrement
makeCoin parameter _value flows directly into the mint arithmetic
balanceOf parameter _owner is a transient mapping key used only for the read
withdrawTo parameter _to is a transient recipient argument of withdrawTo
